result.instructions: Tools for Workable, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which candidates are in the interview stage for our open engineering roles?"; "Show me all scheduled interviews for this week and who is on each one."; "Add a comment to Jane Doe's candidate record that the reference check is done.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Workable data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run workable_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run workable_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run workable_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. workable_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: workable_list_accounts
tools.title: List accounts
tools.description: List the Workable accounts this API token can access, with the subdomain and name. Good first call to confirm the connection. GET /accounts.

tools.name: workable_list_stages
tools.title: List pipeline stages
tools.description: List the account's recruitment pipeline stages (slug, name, kind). Use the slugs as stage filters and as target_stage in workable_move_candidate. GET /stages.

tools.name: workable_list_disqualification_reasons
tools.title: List disqualification reasons
tools.description: List the account's disqualification reasons. Read-only reference data. GET /disqualification_reasons.

tools.name: workable_list_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List the account's hiring team members (id, name, email, roles, status). Use a member id as member_id when writing a comment or moving a candidate. GET /members.

role.description: Filter by role, for example ats.admin or ats.reviewer.

shortcode.description: Only members on this job (job shortcode).

status.description: Filter by status, for example active or deactivated.

since_id.description: Return results with an ID greater than or equal to this ID.

max_id.description: Return results with an ID lower than or equal to this ID.

tools.name: workable_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List the account's jobs (shortcode, title, state, created and updated times). Filter by state or by time. GET /jobs.

state.description: Job state, for example draft, published or closed.

created_after.description: Only jobs created after this time: ISO 8601 (for example 2026-01-31T00:00:00Z) or Unix time in seconds.

updated_after.description: Only jobs updated after this time: ISO 8601 (for example 2026-01-31T00:00:00Z) or Unix time in seconds.

since_id.description: Return results with an ID greater than or equal to this ID.

max_id.description: Return results with an ID lower than or equal to this ID.

tools.name: workable_get_job
tools.title: Get a job
tools.description: Get one job by its shortcode, with its full details. GET /jobs/{shortcode}.

tools.name: workable_list_job_stages
tools.title: List a job's stages
tools.description: List the recruitment pipeline stages of one job, in order. GET /jobs/{shortcode}/stages.

tools.name: workable_list_recruiters
tools.title: List external recruiters
tools.description: List the account's external recruiters, optionally for one job. Read-only. GET /recruiters.

shortcode.description: Only recruiters on this job (job shortcode).

tools.name: workable_list_candidates
tools.title: List candidates
tools.description: List candidates, optionally for one job, one stage or one email address. Returns name, stage, job and time fields. GET /candidates.

shortcode.description: Only candidates on this job (job shortcode).

stage.description: Only candidates in this stage (stage slug).

email.description: Only candidates with this email address.

created_after.description: Only candidates created after this time: ISO 8601 (for example 2026-01-31T00:00:00Z) or Unix time in seconds.

updated_after.description: Only candidates updated after this time: ISO 8601 (for example 2026-01-31T00:00:00Z) or Unix time in seconds.

since_id.description: Return results with an ID greater than or equal to this ID.

max_id.description: Return results with an ID lower than or equal to this ID.

tools.name: workable_get_candidate
tools.title: Get a candidate
tools.description: Get one candidate by id: profile, job, stage, tags, disqualification state and source. GET /candidates/{id}.

tools.name: workable_list_candidate_activities
tools.title: List a candidate's activity
tools.description: List the activity stream of one candidate (stage moves, comments, ratings, emails). GET /candidates/{id}/activities.

updated_after.description: Only activities updated after this time: ISO 8601 (for example 2026-01-31T00:00:00Z) or Unix time in seconds.

since_id.description: Return results with an ID greater than or equal to this ID.

max_id.description: Return results with an ID lower than or equal to this ID.

tools.name: workable_list_events
tools.title: List scheduled events
tools.description: List scheduled calls, interviews and meetings, with their start and end times and the candidate and job. GET /events.

type.description: Event type: call, interview or meeting.

start_date.description: Only events starting on or after this time: ISO 8601 (for example 2026-01-31T00:00:00Z) or Unix time in seconds.

end_date.description: Only events ending on or before this time: ISO 8601 (for example 2026-01-31T00:00:00Z) or Unix time in seconds.

candidate_id.description: Only events for this candidate id.

shortcode.description: Only events for this job (job shortcode).

member_id.description: Only events for this team member id.

since_id.description: Return results with an ID greater than or equal to this ID.

max_id.description: Return results with an ID lower than or equal to this ID.

tools.name: workable_add_candidate_comment
tools.title: Add a comment to a candidate
tools.description: WRITE: post a comment on a candidate's timeline, as the given team member. Visible to the hiring team. POST /candidates/{id}/comments.

member_id.description: The team member id who writes the comment (from workable_list_members).

annotations.title: Add a comment to a candidate

tools.name: workable_move_candidate
tools.title: Move a candidate to a stage
tools.description: WRITE: move a candidate to another pipeline stage, as the given team member. Moving to a hired stage is refused: hiring stays in Workable. Moving to the same stage again changes nothing. POST /candidates/{id}/move.

member_id.description: The team member id who makes the move (from workable_list_members).

annotations.title: Move a candidate to a stage

prompts.title: Get started with Workable
prompts.description: What you can do with Workable here, with example requests to try.
